concerns.text: FR-001 requires ingestion of *experimental* diffusion data. Task T003 downloads a real dataset, but the fallback synthetic generator (T002) is allowed to run when no real URL is present, effectively weakening FR-001 by permitting non‑experimental data while still claiming the FR is satisfied.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) mandates that every dataset file be checksummed and the checksum recorded. No task in Phase 0 creates or records a checksum for `data/raw/dataset.csv`, violating the data‑hygiene requirement.

Constitution Principle V (Versioning Discipline) requires updating the project's `artifact_hashes` map and the `updated_at` timestamp for any new or changed artifact. No task records these versioning artifacts after creating the raw data directory or after generating the synthetic/real dataset, breaching the version‑discipline rule.
